description: Arrets de bus - Communauté d'agglomération Montluçonnaise - 2013 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ids.craig.fr. Location of bus stops on the territory of the Montluçon conurbation community - 2013. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Bus stops - Communauté d'agglomération Montluçonnaise - 2013" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include transport en commun, bus, MAELIS, arrêts. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
